Yara: Quick FYI I merged a reorganization for optkit examples into a nested layout (examples/batching/, examples/kv/). The staging linkcheck surfaced a few orphaned links and broken snippet imports. PR #5264
Ben: Can you paste the top offenders from the linkcheck?
Yara: Sure, preview highlights:
- docs/cookbook/latency_tweaks.md -> references /optimize/examples/batching_v1.json (404)
- src/snippets/python/kv_demo.py -> imports redwood.optimize.prefetch (module not found)
- docs/snippets/quant_profile_quickstart.md -> old anchor /optimize/quant_profiles/quickstart#mixed-precision

Iris: Ok. My vote: add a small legacy mapping file and a lightweight Sphinx redirect generator so we don't rush-deleting files. Also update snippet imports in place and leave a MIGRATION comment.
Ben: Agreed. Minimal plan:
1) docs/_data/optkit_legacy_map.yml with old->new mappings
2) Sphinx transform that emits tiny redirect pages for old URLs (docs/_ext/redirects.py)
3) Preprocessor that applies simple regex rewrites to snippets during staging builds (opt-in env var)
4) Update canonical snippet sources in small PRs

Yara: I'll own the mapping + list of exact legacy paths. Draft mapping:
```yaml
- old: "optimize/examples/batching_v1.json"
  new: "optkit/examples/batching/shortseq/batching_smallseq_v2.json"
- old: "optimize/kv_prefetch_example.py"
  new: "optkit/examples/kv/kv-prefetch-python-0.4.py"
- old: "optimize/quant_profiles/quickstart"
  new: "optkit/quant-profiles/quickstart.md"
```
Iris: For anchors, we should include an anchors.json that maps legacy tokens to new fragment IDs, otherwise product pages linking to #mixed-precision will break. I'll add a small client fallback that reads the fragment and rewrites it if needed. Low risk.
Ben: Good. I'll take the snippet source fixes (python/js). I'll grep for "redwood.optimize" and replace with "redwood.optkit" and append a one-liner comment: `# MIGRATION: canonical -> /optkit/...` in the affected files. PR by EOD.
Yara: Can you also check for filename case changes? Some examples were converted from snake_case to kebab-case. The mapping should include both patterns.
Iris: I'll implement the Sphinx redirect transform. Implementation notes: read docs/_data/optkit_legacy_map.yml, for each mapping emit a small HTML file at the legacy path with a 301-level meta refresh + JS fragment fallback using anchors.json. Keep it opt-in behind an env var so CI can test both behaviours.
Ben: For the snippet preprocessor, prefer a conservative regex that only touches imports at the top of the file. We don't want to rewrite runtime strings by accident. I'll share the sed commands in the PR description.
Yara: docs-bot: staging preview URL once mapping stub is in? Please post.

docs-bot: Preview published: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/5264 (linkcheck: 7 errors remain) :mag_right:

Iris: I'll take 4 of those (redirect pages + anchors), Ben take 2 (snippets), Yara take 1 (cookbook manual patch).
Ben: One more nit: the kv_prefetch snippet imports `redwood.optimize.prefetch.prefetch_client` and downstream tests rely on the exact import string. We'll update the snippet and add a short compatibility shim module in the package that re-exports old names to avoid breaking partner tests immediately. That shim can be removed after the 14-day window.
Yara: Good idea. Add a note in the PR that the shim is temporary and include a deletion date.
Iris: Also recommend adding telemetry ping in the redirect HTML (non-identifying) so we can measure traffic to legacy URLs and pick the right deletion date.
Ben: I'll open the python/js snippet PRs after grep. Expect 5 files for python and 3 for js. I'll include the MIGRATION comments and a small test that imports the updated snippet modules in CI.
Yara: After merges, we'll re-run full linkcheck and then create a CHORE ticket to remove legacy files two weeks later. I'll update the PR description with the two-step workflow and tag #integrations.
Iris: Sounds solid. If anything blocks on CI flakiness from the templates, we can flip the env var off and iterate.
Yara: Thanks all, posting grep output in 10m and will coordinate merges. :thumbsup:
